explication: cursor-byok is a cross-platform desktop app and local model gateway for Cursor. Users configure and test model channels, start the local service, then send Cursor Agent requests through protocol adaptation and provider routing; the gateway supports multi-turn conversations and tool workflows. The desktop also exposes usage dashboards, call inspection, plugin/resource management, and settings. The README documents the end-to-end gateway flow; sampled source and the SOURCE INDEX support selected internal links, but unsampled handler wiring is not asserted.
